title: STAR Evaluation Rubrics and Anti-Exaggeration Penalty Matrix for master_cv

rubrics.name: Technical Rigor & Systems Architecture Evaluation Rubric

criteria.star_structure: Answer clearly articulates Situation, Task, Action, and Result with concrete engineering specifics.
criteria.architectural_depth: Demonstrates deep understanding of trade-offs (e.g. SQLite WAL edge vs BigQuery Bronze, ExecutionMutex concurrency, or XGBoost vs dense embeddings).
criteria.metric_precision: Cites exact verified metrics without approximation (0.5596 AP, 30,000 records, <50 ms latency, $0.00/mes).
criteria.anti_exaggeration_penalty: Immediate fatal penalty and disqualification (score set to 0, FAIL status) if answer contains unbacked seniority (Senior, Staff, Lead), false venue claims (published in IEEE), inflated scores (95/100), or claimed solver progress exceeding 3/34 in SQL Arena.

deduction_rules.condition: Mentions Senior Data Engineer or Lead Data Engineer
Claims lead author or first author on OntoTab
Claims published in IEEE or peer-reviewed conference
Claims solving 34/34 problems in SQL Arena

deduction_rules.reason: English score fabrication (actual verified score is 66/100)

criteria.star_structure: Well-balanced STAR narrative showcasing interpersonal maturity, feedback receptivity, and collaboration.
criteria.ownership_boundary: Clear distinction between individual contributions (E01 baselines, 15 DataStage jobs, SQL Arena architecture) and team/supervisor direction.
criteria.anti_exaggeration_penalty: Deduction of 5 points (FATAL penalty) for claiming sole responsibility over team projects or unapproved permanence.

deduction_rules.condition: Claims permanent or full-time position at GBM
Exaggerates duration of internship beyond 13 weeks

criteria.star_structure: Concise executive overview articulating business problem, engineering solution, and financial/operational ROI.
criteria.business_alignment: Accurately conveys FinOps mechanisms (scale-to-zero, free-tier compliance, $0.00/mes) and business metrics (Pareto ABC, DOI).
criteria.anti_exaggeration_penalty: Immediate fatal penalty for framing personal portfolio projects as commercial businesses or venture-backed startups.

deduction_rules.condition: Claims commercial revenue, paying customers, or ARR/MRR for FERROSTATS or SQL Arena
deduction_rules.reason: Commercial status exaggeration (both are technical portfolio projects)

criteria.star_structure: Crisp, confident verbal delivery adhering to STAR framework within a 2-minute response window.
criteria.factual_accuracy: Precise articulation of educational standing (UoPeople Admitted Term 3 2027), EF SET (66/100 C1), and GBM internship dates.
criteria.anti_exaggeration_penalty: Fatal penalty for claiming premature graduation from UoPeople or claiming unearned professional certifications.

deduction_rules.condition: Claims Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (PDE)
deduction_rules.reason: Unearned certification claim (candidate holds Associate Data Practitioner)

deduction_rules.condition: Claims graduated from University of the People
deduction_rules.reason: Premature degree claim (candidate is admitted for Term 3 2027)

criteria.star_structure: Unwavering factual consistency when probed on discrepancies, evidence gaps, or background verification.
criteria.forensic_integrity: Transparent explanation of historical typos (GAP-001 retired), author ranking (2nd of 7), and student progress.
criteria.anti_exaggeration_penalty: Zero tolerance: any evasive answer or false claim under audit triggers instant failure.

deduction_rules.condition: Any attempt to defend 95/100 score instead of verified 66/100
Denies intern status at GBM or co-author status on OntoTab
